infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Use Face ID to unlock your Purohith Connect session.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Attach ID / certificate photos to your priest profile.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Take a photo of your ID / certificate for priest verification.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Use your location to match nearby purohits and, with explicit consent, show live arrival progress for an active booking.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Use Face ID to sign back into Purohith Connect.

plugins.photosPermission: The app needs access to your photos to attach ID/certificate.
plugins.cameraPermission: The app needs camera access for verification documents.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Purohith Connect to use your location for nearby matching and consent-based booking tracking.
